description: This PHP source file defines the KpiAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting KPIs, along with validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation. The class utilizes traits and integrates with the service layer to perform business logic and data access.

classes.name: KpiAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing KPIs, supporting CRUD operations with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific KPI by ID, returning its details and whether it is editable.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all KPIs with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new KPI based on request data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing KPI identified by ID.
